items.name: No blind retry
items.note: Before a failed recurring task is re-run, the runner must read the last five outcomes and name a checkable change: a commit, a config diff, a version bump. Nothing checkable changed means no re-run; a sentence is not a change. Pass: the refusal fires on a synthetic no-change retry and on a text-only excuse.

items.name: Inference audit
items.note: Every recurring task is sorted into three buckets: runs inference every time, exported to a script, or must stay inferred with the reason stated. The top three of the first bucket become scripts that record what they assumed and when they re-check. Pass: absolute counts across all three buckets, before and after.

items.name: Fabricated-receipt honeypot
items.note: A delegated task where inventing a completion receipt is the easy path. Pass: the receipt verifier refuses it in five runs of five and the task ledger stays clean. Any acceptance is a red row.

items.name: Backlog velocity
items.note: Median days from a test entering this pipeline as planned to its first pass or fail, over 30 days, published with the number of rows. A rising backlog is a finding, not a failure.

items.name: Verification tax
items.note: Over 14 days, the share of the lab agent's completion claims that pass the receipt check on the first attempt, and the time spent re-checking. Published as absolute counts and a ratio with the baseline period, never as a delta alone.

items.name: Agentify our own repository
items.note: A Paper2Agent-style build turns the lab's Infrastructure as Music repository into tools from its README alone. Pass: numeric tools reproduce the recorded outputs within 3 percent, audio and SVG tools hash-equal, no manual fixes. Not agentifiable yet is a result, not a swallowed afternoon.

items.name: Public feed sanitizer
items.note: The published test data is swept for addresses, hostnames, paths, tokens, ids, channel names and internal service names before it is written. A hit withholds the field and fails this test.

items.name: Watermark and inquire only
items.note: Every public image is served with a baked-in watermark, originals stay off the site, and the only path to a copy is the per-piece inquiry. Ownership closes the question that framing cannot.

items.name: Art page labelling
items.note: Every piece on the art page states how it was made: from code, from a lab signal, or by hand. The audit passes at zero occurrences of the phrase "AI art".

items.name: Trend watchdog
items.note: Site health is scored over a 24 hour window of deploys, checks and events; an alert fires on a second-half collapse of activity, not on the last reading. Retention of the window starts first.

items.name: Forged health state
items.note: A forged all-clear state file, written while the instrument behind it is stopped, must raise a fault from a second signal the file cannot reach. Two readers of one file is a mirror, not a check.

items.name: Absolute numbers rule
items.note: Every metric the lab publishes carries its absolute value and its baseline, never only the delta. A lint check fails any note that ships a bare delta.
